CAD drawings under floor plans, config backups from Oxidized, end-of-life data, a personal sidebar, SFTP backups, bulk editing on the routing and power lists, and every bug report filed since 0.17.2.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> **Scripts: the sandbox default is now `auto`.** Where bubblewrap works (it is installed by `install.sh --with-script-sandbox` and in the Docker image), sandboxed scripts run in their own namespaces and can reach **only the Danbyte API**, not devices or other hosts. A sandboxed script that talks to devices directly needs `DANBYTE_SCRIPT_SANDBOX=landlock`, which keeps the 0.17.2 behaviour. Trusted scripts are unchanged. The stock Docker stack falls back to Landlock, because Docker's default profiles block bubblewrap.

> [!NOTE]
> **Behaviour changes:**
> - **FHRP authentication keys** move into the secret store during the upgrade (the built-in encrypted local store when none is configured) and are shown only through an audited Reveal. Old change-log entries are masked.
> - **Spreadsheet import** saves through the same rules as the API: read-only columns are ignored, four types are export-only (ACME orders, certificate bindings, floor plan drawings, Redfish endpoints), and a dry run applies the same checks as the real import.
> - **Single deletes** of routing objects still in use are refused with the reason, like bulk delete.
> - **Deleting a port** also removes a cable left with no port on that end.
> - **A JSON body that isn't an object** gets one shared 400 shape (`non_field_errors`) on every endpoint.

### CAD drawings in floor plans

- **Upload a DXF, or a DWG,** as a floor plan's background. The Docker image ships LibreDWG's `dwg2dxf` for DWG; bare-metal installs can point `DANBYTE_CAD_CONVERTER` at it or at the ODA File Converter.
- **True scale:** the drawing's units line up with the grid's cell size; unitless files are calibrated with two clicks. **Fit grid to drawing** sizes the grid from it.
- **Layers panel** with show and hide, an "Architecture only" preset and a text toggle. Default-colour lines follow the light or dark theme.
- **In every view:** the editor, the 3D room floor, PNG export and the new **vector PDF export** (A4/A3/Letter/Tabloid, scale bar, legend, title block).
- **Editor:** undo and redo (100 steps), multi-select with move, rotate and delete, and a better "Find on plan".

### Features

- #98 - **VMware Cloud Director sync, finished:** VM groups (vApps) get list and detail pages, filters and search; Proxmox pools and vCenter folders sync into the same groups; NICs are read once per vApp instead of once per VM, so large estates stay inside the sync timeout.
- #35 - **Device config backups from Oxidized:** current config, history and diffs on a device's Config tab. Reading configs needs the new `view_config` permission, which no built-in role includes.
- #8 - **End-of-life data from endoflife.date,** off by default: map platforms to products, see status on platforms and as a device/VM column, and add an end-of-life compliance check. Airgapped installs can import the catalog from a file.
- #285 - **Personal sidebar:** hide and reorder sections and pages under Preferences, with a tenant default. Long list filters get a search box and can be hidden per list.
- #319 - **SFTP backup destination,** with host-key confirmation, schedules and retention. Passphrase-protected OpenSSH keys work.
- #313 - **Power panels and feeds:** multi-select, bulk edit and safe bulk delete. Power panels can have a location.
- #314 - **All 17 routing lists:** multi-select, bulk edit and safe bulk delete with a preview of what is kept.
- #344 - **MAC address list:** a Location column showing where each MAC was learned.
- #345 - **Device components:** Front ports and Rear ports get their own tabs, and every component table gets the column picker.
- #276 - **Searchable pickers on every object field,** with colour badges kept.
- **Device-type bundles can carry their photos** (base64), so a library moves between installs with its pictures and calibration.
- **Scheduled SNMP polling from the core** (Off / 15 / 30 / 60 minutes), skipping devices bound to an Outpost.
- **Live traffic on the site map:** a Utilization colour mode, each line split by direction.
- **Per-tenant rack capacity levels** (replacing the fixed 80/95 %) and a **rack power budget**.
- **SLA:** incident causes, ticket links and dispute flags; scheduled weekly and monthly reports; agreement templates; CSV/JSON metrics export.

### Security

- #316 - **Sandboxed scripts run in bubblewrap** (namespaces, no network but the API) on top of 0.17.2's Landlock confinement. See the note at the top.
- #364 - **Spreadsheet import can no longer mark a script trusted.**
- #365 - **Spreadsheet import can no longer point a credential at another Vault path.**
- #383 - **FHRP authentication keys are stored in the secret store** and revealed only with the reveal permission.
- **WinRM and vSphere connections are pinned to the checked address**; SSO and SAML addresses that resolve to a private network log a warning.
- **Container images publish only after the test suite passes** for that tag.

### Fixed

- #366 - **Moving a module to another bay, or changing its type, keeps its interfaces** with their cables, IPs and links. Removing ports that carry a cable or IP needs confirmation.
- #367 - **Bulk-cloned interfaces no longer belong to the module** of the interface they were cloned from.
- #368 - **Grouped topology no longer fails** for a user whose permission has an empty list constraint.
- #369 - **One refused PagerDuty event no longer drops the rest of a grouped alert burst;** refused events are retried.
- #370 - **An import file without a key column updates existing rows again.**
- #371 - **Objects named "Global", "None" or "-" survive an unchanged re-import.**
- #372 - **Deep IP list pages are as fast as the first.**
- #373 - **Malformed request bodies and parameters get a 400, not a 500,** on every endpoint.
- #374 - **Workbooks that unpack too large are refused** before they are read.
- #375 - **A full-depth device blocks the opposite face** of its units.
- #376 - **A rack can't be made shorter than its installed devices.**
- #377 - **A device can't be put in a rack at another site.**
- #378 - **Cables can't lose an end or connect incompatible ports.** `manage.py check_dcim_integrity` lists existing problems.
- #379 - **IP ranges can't overlap or sit outside their prefix.**
- #380 - **Shrinking a prefix or VLAN group is refused while something would be left outside;** VLANs already stranded can be edited again.
- #381 - **Aggregates are stored in canonical form and their utilisation counts each network once.** `manage.py check_aggregates` lists stored duplicates the upgrade couldn't merge.
- #382 - **IPv6 utilisation, next available and search agree.**
- **Docker:** sandboxed scripts reach the API through the backend service.
- **vCenter platforms use VMware Tools' OS name** (for example "Microsoft Windows Server 2022 (64-bit)") instead of vCenter's internal code, which labels Server 2022 as `WINDOWS_SERVER_2021_64`. Platforms an earlier sync named after that code move to the real name on the next sync; platforms you picked are kept.
- **Existing Proxmox and vCenter sources start syncing VM groups** (pools and folders) on their next sync; turn off "Sync pools/folders/vApps as VM groups" on a source to keep them ungrouped.

### Upgrades

- **Base images come from ECR Public,** not Docker Hub; `BASE_IMAGE_REGISTRY` points the build at another mirror.
- **Every NOT NULL column added since the previous release must have a database default,** so processes still running the old code keep working right after the migrations (checked by a test against the last release).

Thank you @deku-m, @jorge-madrigal, @SerhiiZahuba and @PVM-NL for the reports and requests.
